front: Build a GenAI application on foundation models with the LEAST operational overhead
back:
Amazon Bedrock: fully managed, one API to 100+ foundation models, pay per token.
Không host model, không quản lý server, đổi model trong cùng API.

front: Answers must come from company documents that change often, with citations
back:
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases (managed RAG).
Tài liệu mới chỉ cần sync, không train lại model, và câu trả lời kèm nguồn.

front: Block a topic, mask PII, and detect ungrounded answers with the same safeguards across models
back:
Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filters, denied topics, word filters, sensitive information filters, contextual grounding checks, Automated Reasoning checks.
Guardrails lọc input và output, không làm model biết thêm.

front: Are prompts and outputs on Amazon Bedrock used to train models or shared with model providers?
back:
No. AWS and model providers do not use Bedrock inputs or outputs to train models, and inputs and outputs are not shared with model providers.
Đây là đáp án cho stakeholder lo data công ty train model của vendor.

front: Full control over model training, algorithms, and deployment on proprietary data
back:
Amazon SageMaker AI (renamed from Amazon SageMaker on 2024-12-03).
Chọn khi có team data science và cần custom ML, không chọn mặc định cho GenAI.

front: Data scientists want to start from a pre-trained open-source model and fine-tune it
back:
Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: pretrained open-source models, solution templates, example notebooks.
Rút ngắn thời gian build nhưng vẫn nằm trong SageMaker AI, team vẫn cần ML skill.

front: Give every employee an approved AI assistant for search, research, dashboards, and automation without development
back:
Amazon Quick: Quick Sight, Quick Index, Quick Research, Quick Flows, Quick Automate, Apps in Quick; seat-based pricing. Quick evolved from QuickSight, and AWS positions it as the next evolution of Amazon Q Business.
Đáp án điển hình để thay shadow AI bằng công cụ được duyệt.

front: AWS CAF: six perspectives and four transformation phases
back:
Perspectives: Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, Operations. Phases: Envision, Align, Launch, Scale.
CAF for AI thêm capability responsible use of AI vào Governance perspective.

front: Large GenAI job, results needed the next day, lowest cost
back:
Amazon Bedrock batch inference: 50% lower price than on-demand for supported models.
Không cần real-time thì batch hoặc Flex tier là đòn bẩy cost lớn nhất.

Reserved (reserved tokens-per-minute, 1 or 3 months, 99.5% uptime target), Priority (premium, fastest), Standard (default), Flex (discount, slower).
Chọn tier theo mức quan trọng và độ chờ được của workload.

front: Steady SageMaker AI usage for years: lower the hourly cost
back:
SageMaker AI Savings Plans: commit to $/hour for 1 or 3 years, up to 64% savings.
Compute Savings Plans không áp cho SageMaker AI.

front: Estimate AI costs for a business case before building
back:
AWS Pricing Calculator: free planning tool with upfront, monthly, and annual estimates.
Cost Explorer và Budgets chỉ dùng sau khi đã có usage.

front: Analyze what drives AI spend, split it by team, and forecast it
back:
AWS Cost Explorer (13 months history, 18 months forecast, Savings Plans recommendations) plus activated cost allocation tags to filter by team.
AWS Budgets nằm ngoài scope AIB-C01.

front: Buy a partner's AI solution or agent with custom pricing and charges on the AWS bill
back:
AWS Marketplace, with a private offer for custom pricing and EULA.
Đây là con đường buy hoặc partner trong quyết định build-buy-partner.

front: Shared responsibility for a Bedrock application: who owns what?
back:
AWS: security of the cloud (data centers, hardware, hosting the models). Customer: data, access control, classification, responsible use, and regulatory compliance.
Dùng managed service không chuyển trách nhiệm về data và compliance sang AWS.

front: Structured review of an AI workload against responsible AI best practices
back:
AWS Well-Architected Responsible AI Lens: controllability, privacy, security, safety, veracity, robustness, fairness, explainability, transparency, governance.
Generative AI Lens thì tập trung vào kiến trúc GenAI theo 6 pillar.

front: AWS offerings in scope for AIB-C01
back:
Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Quick, AWS CAF, shared responsibility model, AI pricing structures, Cost Explorer, Marketplace, Pricing Calculator.
Service khác không được hỏi.

Essentials 3 USD, Professional 20 USD, Enterprise 40 USD per user per month, plus a 250 USD infrastructure fee per account.
Seat-based: cost dự đoán được, theo dõi adoption để không trả seat thừa.

front: Mission-critical, steady Bedrock workload needs reserved capacity
back:
Bedrock Reserved tier: fixed price per 1K tokens-per-minute, 1- or 3-month term, 99.5% uptime target. Savings Plans do not cover Bedrock.
Đừng chọn Compute Savings Plans cho Bedrock.
